title: FakeAgent reported C2 IP endpoint
description: An HTTP(S) URL in a tool command or uniquely correlated network observation uses the reported SectopRAT C2 IP as its host.
falsepositives: Authorized threat research may access this IP.
investigation: Check destination port, protocol, response, process lineage, and contemporaneous intelligence before treating this as active C2.

classification.rationale: An IP indicator alone does not identify an ATLAS or OWASP LLM behavior.
